import numpy as np
def blocks(A):
    h,w=A.shape; seen=set(); res=[]
    for i in range(h-1):
        for j in range(w-1):
            if A[i,j]==2 and (i,j) not in seen:
                res.append((i,j)); seen|={(i,j),(i,j+1),(i+1,j),(i+1,j+1)}
    return res
def analyze(inp,out,name):
    A=np.array(inp); B=np.array(out); bs=blocks(A)
    print(name)
    for k,(i,j) in enumerate(bs):
        col=B[i,j]
        # adjacency to other blocks (8-neighborhood of block region)
        adj=[]
        for (a,b) in bs:
            if (a,b)==(i,j): continue
            if a-2<=i<=a+2 and b-2<=j<=b+2: adj.append((a,b))
        print(k,(i,j),'color',col,'adj',adj)
